ONNX Runtime Web 1.23.2 — plain WASM build (no JSEP / asyncify / JSPI)
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime · npm onnxruntime-web@1.23.2, files from dist/, unmodified.

Served same-origin since the 2026-11-18 audit (docs/AUDIT-2026-11-18.md, M4) instead of from
cdn.jsdelivr.net, so a CDN compromise or outage can't reach this origin or stop the ML features.
The version is in the folder name, so a cached copy is always the right one; an upgrade is a new
folder. SHA-256 (checked by `npm test` against the npm release):
  ort.wasm.min.mjs              69751720f611e37d1ce2fa3c6ebaa80f949014752636c5f8887a63d40feadcc7
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs    90a557d15c02bac4504d95b67f431d8594635ed2a0a62a7f2cd83d090ff91d3e
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm   45eaee27761ad883742a8d4b8fce1538d60ce43b51adf1726fafccc59b8c1a15
Why 1.23.2 and not newer: microsoft/onnxruntime#33426 (see stem-model-core.js).
